scope: Vehicle hours come from the public page above. Pedestrian hours, for gates with pedestrian_hours, come from pedestrian_source; elsewhere pedestrian status is 'not_stated' unless someone observed it. Holidays have no pedestrian hours, so they show 'not_stated'.
pedestrian_source: USC Transportation's 2026 UPC Pedestrian and Vehicle Gate Schedule (given to the team by Transportation, Nov 2026). DPS opens and closes some gates within an hour; that hour is listed as uncertain.
holidays_note: The page has a Holiday column but no list of dates. Add ISO dates here (e.g. 2026-11-26) or holiday hours never apply.
